annotations.title: Company events feed from SEC filings

description: Return FinancialMD's own company events, newest first, across all companies or one. Built only from SEC filings as EDGAR accepts them: 8-K and 6-K (earnings, restatements, officer changes, M&A, bankruptcy...), Schedule 13D and 13G stakes, Rule 425 merger communications, late-filing notices (NT 10-K), S-1 registrations and clusters of insider purchases. Each event has a type, an importance from 1 to 5 with the rule that set it, a headline FinancialMD generates by rule from the filing's own facts (labelled, never a wire headline), key numbers quoted with their passage, and the filing link. Amendments fold under the original. Use it for what happened at a company or across the market; it is not wire news.

amendments.description: collapse lists an amendment under its original (amended_by); all shows every filing as its own event.

as_of.description: Knowledge date or timestamp (YYYY-MM-DD or RFC 3339). The answer is what FinancialMD knew at that instant: only facts whose known interval contains as_of. Omit for the current view.

company.description: Optional: one company. Company identifier: a FinancialMD id ("fmd_01H..."), an SEC CIK ("cik:320193"), or a ticker ("ticker:AAPL", optionally with the MIC "ticker:AAPL.XNAS"). A bare ticker like "AAPL" is accepted and sent as ticker:AAPL. An issuer on an EU or UK regulated market that does not file with the SEC has no CIK: pass its LEI ("lei:IOG4E947OATN0KJYSD45") or its fmd_ id.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page (data.next_cursor).

event_type.description: Only events of this type (earnings, restatement, leadership_change, acquisition_disposition, bankruptcy, activist_stake, passive_stake, merger_communication, late_filing, registration, insider_buying_cluster...).

form.description: Only events from this form, for example 8-K, 6-K, 13D, 13G, 425, NT 10-K, S-1.

importance_min.description: Only events at least this important (5 critical, 4 major, 3 notable, 2 routine, 1 minor).

limit.description: Maximum number of periods or items to return (default 20, at most 200).

name: event_feed

outputSchema.description: The FinancialMD envelope (docs/API.md section 2): data plus meta (request_id, as_of knowledge time, matched company, coverage, pipeline_version, licence, terms, proof_base). Every numeric value inside data is an object with value, unit, currency, period, known interval, restated flag, method and a proof pointing at the filing. On failure the result is isError with an error object instead.

data.description: { items: [{ id, company, event_type, event_types, importance, importance_rule, headline, headline_generated_by, headline_method, form, items, accession, amended_by, party_role, counterparty, filed, accepted_at, key_numbers: [{ label, value, unit, quote, document_url, char_start, char_end }], exhibits, source_url, retrieved_at }], next_cursor, note }

error.description: Present only on isError results: the API error code and message plus remedy hints.

meta.description: Request metadata: request_id, as_of, company resolution, coverage, pipeline_version, licence, terms, proof_base.

attribution.description: Citations a source requires on anything shown from the answer.

title: Company events feed from SEC filings
